title: Mattermost versions 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.1 Mattermost fail to apply…
description: Mattermost versions 11.7.x through 11.10.x (up to specified patch levels) contain a vulnerability in the WebSocket msgpack decoder where allocation limits are not properly enforced. This flaw allows an authenticated remote attacker to cause excessive server memory allocation by sending a crafted binary WebSocket frame with a large declared Bin32 payload length. The issue leads to a denial-of-service condition due to resource exhaustion.
